svg.title: Companies listing bulk powder with FDA, by where they are registered
svg.desc: Bar chart of companies with a current FDA listing for bulk ingredient or further-processing powder, as of FDA data dated October 16, 2026. Semaglutide (Wegovy, Ozempic): 47 companies, 23 registered in China or Hong Kong, 19 elsewhere, 5 not matched; Tirzepatide (Zepbound, Mounjaro): 37 companies, 20 registered in China or Hong Kong, 14 elsewhere, 3 not matched; BPC-157 (never approved): 16 companies, 12 registered in China or Hong Kong, 3 elsewhere, 1 not matched; Retatrutide (not approved): 7 companies, 7 registered in China or Hong Kong, 0 elsewhere, 0 not matched; Cagrilintide (not approved): 2 companies, 2 registered in China or Hong Kong, 0 elsewhere, 0 not matched.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
